detailZh: 安东内利 F1世界冠军的可能性：梅赛德斯车手如何在美国大奖赛中赢得世界冠军
他只有微乎其微的机会，但安东内利将在下站比赛中首次有机会创造F1历史，成为2026年的世界冠军；10月23日至25日，在天空体育 F1上观看美国大奖赛直播
天空体育F1的Martin Brundle与安东内利坐下来讨论他在梅赛德斯到目前为止的职业生涯，因为他越来越接近第一个F1世界冠军
安东内利可能成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军，时间可能就在下站的美国大奖赛——10月25日。
梅赛德斯车队的安东内利在新加坡大奖赛中以第三名的成绩，将车手积分榜的领先优势扩大到了赛季最高的102分。
乔治·拉塞尔在积分榜上仍然排名第二，但引擎处罚导致他起跑时位于最后一排，这使得他首次落后于队友超过100分。而刘易斯·汉密尔顿在颁奖仪式上的失误使得法拉利车手在第三名的位置上落后111分。

在领先如此大的优势下，并且2026赛季还剩下六场比赛，世界冠军现在看起来对于这位20岁的意大利人在F1的第二年来说只是形式上的，他将取代塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔成为最年轻的世界冠军。
第一次机会——尽管是外部的——将在下一场在奥斯汀的美洲赛车场举行的比赛中到来，该比赛将在天空体育F1直播...
安东内利如何在美国大奖赛赢得冠军
美国大奖赛将于10月25日星期日举行后，将剩下五场计划中的比赛——墨西哥、巴西、拉斯维加斯、卡塔尔和阿布扎比——最多还有125个积分可以争夺。
要在奥斯汀赢得冠军，安东内利需要将他的积分领先优势增加23分。为了实现这一点，他必须赢得大奖赛，并且希望拉塞尔和汉密尔顿没有获得足够的积分，以保持在墨西哥的124分之内。
安东内利在奥斯汀成为冠军的可能性包括：
拉塞尔排名第九或更低（2分或更少）。
汉密尔顿排名第五或更低（10分或以下）
乔治·拉塞尔在新加坡大奖赛冲刺赛雨中延迟期间接替安东内利的工程师
如果安东内利赢得比赛而拉塞尔排名第九，安东内利将领先他的队友125分，剩下125分未比赛。但即使如此，安东内利仍然有可能成为冠军，前提是汉密尔顿在比赛中也仍然不在前四名之内。
这是因为奥斯汀的胜利将是意大利人的今年第九个胜利，而拉塞尔已经赢得了三个胜利，在英国人剩下的五场比赛中最多只能赢得八个胜利。因此，安东内利将因此确保通过结果回溯获得冠军，在赛季末积分平局的情况下，比赛胜利将是首要的平局解决手段。
其他仍在数学上存在夺冠可能的司机有哪些？
在新加坡站之后，马克斯·维斯塔潘（落后119分）、查尔斯·勒克莱尔（落后125分）和兰多·诺里斯（落后139分）也仍然在数学上存在夺冠可能，但无论他们在奥斯汀站的比赛中如何结束，安东内利的胜利都会自动将他们淘汰出局。
托托·沃尔夫反驳了梅赛德斯车队更偏爱安东内利而非拉塞尔的指控
‘如果我没有做好我的工作，那么结果就不会到来’——安东内利誓言要保持专注
安东内利现在离一个令人难以置信的历史性成就仅一步之遥，但在新加坡之后他强调，他不能让这个事实分散他在奥斯汀的表现。
“我知道它非常接近，我知道它在那里，但我只是需要确保我继续做到最好，”他说。
“你知道，心态始终如一，就是要出去赢得比赛，以我能做到的最佳方式表现。我认为这个周末[在新加坡]我并没有特别开得好。我觉得我可以做得更好，但我对一周的休息和重新调整感到自信，我真的很期待回到奥斯汀。

“但是，归根结底，如果我没有做好我的工作，那么结果就不会出现。所以为了实现我的目标，我需要表现得好，就这么简单。”

detailEn: Kimi Antonelli F1 title permutations: How Mercedes driver could clinch world championship at United States GP

He only has an outside chance, but Kimi Antonelli will have a first opportunity to make F1 history and become 2026's world champion as soon as the next race; watch the United States Grand Prix live on Sky Sports F1 on October 23-25
Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle sits down with Kimi Antonelli to discuss his career thus far at Mercedes as he moves closer to a first F1 world title
Kimi Antonelli could become Formula 1's youngest world champion as early as the next race - the United States Grand Prix - on October 25.
Mercedes' Antonelli increased his lead at the top of the Drivers' Championship to a season-high 102 points with a third-place finish in the Singapore Grand Prix.

George Russell remains second in the standings but a ninth-place finish after engine penalties had left him starting at the back of the grid dropped him beyond a century of points behind his team-mate for the first time, while Lewis Hamilton's late slide off the podium leaves the Ferrari driver 111 points off the pace in third place.

With such a large lead and with a scheduled six races left in the 2026 season, the world title now looks a formality for the 20-year-old Italian in just his second year of F1 to usurp Sebastian Vettel as the sport's youngest title winner.
A first chance - albeit an outside one - to clinch the crown will arrive as soon as the next race at Austin's Circuit of the Americas, live on Sky Sports F1…
How Antonelli could win the title at the United States GP

There will be five scheduled races left - Mexico, Brazil, Las Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi - after the United States Grand Prix takes place on Sunday October 25 and a maximum of 125 points left to play for.

To win the title in Austin, Antonelli needs to increase his championship lead by 23 points. For that to happen he must win the grand prix AND then hope both Russell and Hamilton do not score sufficient points to stay within 124 points of him going to Mexico.
The permutations for Antonelli to become champion in Austin are:
Russell finishes ninth or lower (2 points or less)
Hamilton finishes fifth or lower (10 points or less)
George Russell takes over from Antonelli's engineer during the Sprint rain delay in Singapore

Were Antonelli to win the race and Russell finish ninth, Antonelli would hold a 125-point lead over his team-mate with exactly 125 points left to play for. But that would still be enough for Antonelli to become champion, provided Hamilton was also still outside the top four in the race.

That is because victory in Austin would be the the Italian's ninth of the year and with Russell on three wins the Briton would only be able to get to a maximum of eight in the five races left. Antonelli would therefore be guaranteed the title on results countback, with race wins the first tiebreaker in event of an end-of-season points tie.
What about the other drivers still in mathematical contention?

Max Verstappen (119 points back), Charles Leclerc (125 points back) and Lando Norris (139 points back) all remain in mathematical title contention too after Singapore but would all be automatically knocked out by an Antonelli win in Austin wherever they finished that race.
Toto Wolff hits back at accusations that Mercedes favour Antonelli over Russell
'If I don't do my job well, then the result won't come' - Antonelli vows to stay focused
Antonelli is now within touching distance of an incredible historic achievement but stressed after Singapore that he cannot afford to let that fact distract him from his performance in Austin.
"I know it's very close, I know it's there, but I just need to make sure that I keep doing the best I can," he said.

"You know, the mindset is always the same, to go out there and win and perform the best way I can. I think this weekend [in Singapore] I haven't particularly driven that well. I felt like I could have done a better job, but I feel confident that, you know, a week to reset and I'm really looking forward to being back in Austin.
Highlights from the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix
"But, at the end of the day, if I don't do my job well, then the result won't come. So in order to achieve what I want, I need to perform, as simple as that."

detailEn: Mexico City GP: Lando Norris pips Kimi Antonelli in final practice to set up thrilling Mexico qualifying

Lando Norris and Kimi Antonelli were separated by just 0.001s at the top of the timesheet in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix; watch qualifying later at 9pm with Sunday's race at 8pm (build-up from 6.30pm), live on Sky Sports F1

Sky Sports F1's David Croft and Karun Chandok discuss Esteban Ocon being replaced by Haas for the Mexico City GP, Liam Lawson and Max Verstappen being handed a grid penalty for their P2 collision and Isack Hajar's paddock altercation with a fan
McLaren's Lando Norris pipped Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli by 0.001s in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix to set up a thrilling qualifying.
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc had topped both of Friday's practice sessions but McLaren and Mercedes showed their hand to outpace the Monegasque driver by one tenth of a second.
Antonelli is likely to become world champion in Sunday's race as he only needs a top-nine finish to secure the Formula 1 drivers' title.

McLaren's Oscar Piastri was fourth while Red Bull appear to be out of the pole position battle as Max Verstappen was 0.351s off the pace, but there seems to be a genuine three-team fight at the front for qualifying later on Saturday at 9pm (build-up from 8pm), live on Sky Sports F1.
Regardless of what he does in qualifying, Verstappen cannot start on pole position as he and Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson have a one-grid place penalty for colliding in second practice on Friday.
The stewards called the incident "unacceptable", with both drivers admitting the clash was "unnecessary and clumsy".
Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson and Red Bull's Max Verstappen make contact during FP2 at the Mexico City GP - the clash would eventually lead to both drivers receiving a grid penalty
More drama took place before final practice on Saturday as Haas made the shock decision to replace Esteban Ocon with reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa for the remainder of the weekend.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad, with Brazilian youngster Rafael Camara signed as his replacement.
Hirakwa, a 24 Hours of Le Mans winner, has taken part in several practice sessions for Haas over the last two years and was 19th in final practice, six tenths down on team-mate Oliver Bearman.

埃斯特班·奥康已在哈斯被平川亮接替，参加墨西哥城大奖赛剩余赛程。
车队未说明换下奥康的原因，但确认这位法国车手并非患病。
奥康在第二次练习赛后以第13名完赛，在车队无线电中发泄了自己的不满，并且将不再参加本站比赛的任何环节，因为平川亮将在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道顶替他的发车位。
奥康质疑了车队在周五第二次练习赛中让他使用中性胎而非软胎的决定。
这位法国车手在被赛事工程师劳拉·穆勒告知其驾驶计划有变后，恳求道“别这样对我”。
哈斯车队最近确认，奥康将在本赛季结束后离开这支美国所有的车队，他已在队效力两年。
车队声明写道：“TGR哈斯F1车队储备车手平川亮将在本周末墨西哥城大奖赛的剩余赛程中替换埃斯特班·奥康，时间为10月31日星期六至11月1日星期日。”
“平川亮（32岁）曾随丰田GAZOO Racing两度赢得国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛冠军（2022年、2023年），并夺得勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军（2022年）。他于10月30日星期五在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道参加了第一节自由练习，这是他本赛季第三次驾驶VF-26赛车出战自由练习，最终位列全场第15名。”
“这位日本车手将在星期六的第三节自由练习和排位赛以及星期日的71圈大奖赛中与队友奥利·贝尔曼搭档——这将是平川亮的F1正赛首秀。”

detailEn: Esteban Ocon: Haas replace French driver with Ryo Hirakawa for remainder of Mexico City GP weekend without providing reason

Esteban Ocon will take no further part in the Mexico City GP, with Haas replacing French driver with Ryo Hirakawa; Haas gave no reason for Ocon's replacement; Ocon is leaving the team at the end of the season
Esteban Ocon has been replaced by Ryo Hirakawa at Haas for the remainder of the Mexico City Grand Prix.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.

Ocon vented his frustrations on the team radio while finishing 13th following second practice and will take no further part in the race as Hirakawa will take his place on the grid at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodríguez.
Ocon questioned the team's decision to run him on the medium rather than soft tyre during second practice on Friday.
The Frenchman pleaded "don't do this to me" to his race engineer Laura Mueller after being informed of a change to his run-plan.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad.
A team statement read: "TGR Haas F1 Team reserve driver Ryō Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix, Saturday 31 October - Sunday 1 November.

"Hirakawa (32), a two-time winner of the FIA World Endurance Championship (2022, 2023) and 24 Hours of Le Mans Winner (2022) with Toyota GAZOO Racing, participated in FP1 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday 30 October - his third free practice outing of the season driving the VF-26, finishing 15th overall.
"The Japanese driver will partner teammate Ollie Bearman through final practice and qualifying on Saturday and Sunday's 71-lap grand prix - Hirakawa's Formula 1 race debut."
